description: This file defines a class 'Xls' within the PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Shared namespace, providing static methods for calculating cell dimensions and positions in Excel XLS files, including size conversions, cell coordinate transformations, and distances between anchors.

classes.name: Xls
classes.description: Provides static utility methods for handling Excel XLS cell dimensions, coordinate conversions, and anchor calculations.

methods.name: sizeCol
methods.description: Calculates the width of a specified column in pixels based on its Excel width, considering default and explicit dimensions.

methods.name: sizeRow
methods.description: Calculates the height of a specified row in pixels, based on its height in user units, default dimensions, and font metrics.

methods.name: getDistanceX
methods.description: Calculates the horizontal distance in pixels between two anchor points on a worksheet, considering column widths and offsets.

methods.name: getDistanceY
methods.description: Calculates the vertical distance in pixels between two anchor points on a worksheet, considering row heights and offsets.

methods.name: oneAnchor2twoAnchor
methods.description: Converts 1-cell anchor coordinates to 2-cell anchor coordinates for positioning images or objects within a worksheet, including offset calculations.
